gaps.explanation: Classification difference between the two printed statements. The Statement of Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances - Cash Basis - Governmental Funds (trimmed p5, printed p6) prints Total receipts 608,276 and shows 'Grants and donations' 64,861 (General column) under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES), not among receipts. The Budget and Actual schedule for the General Fund (trimmed p8, printed p15; it covers all governmental funds, incl. Streets) prints 'Grants and donations' 64,861 among RECEIPTS, Total receipts 673,137. 673,137 - 64,861 = 608,276 = statement total; all other receipt lines agree. Detail index 9 ('Grants and donations' 64,861) is the schedule's printed revenue line and the statement's other_financing 64,861; both are as printed, so no line is added or removed.
